Title: Resource lock management available in the portal

Body.Content:
Management locks help you prevent accidental deletion or modification of your Azure resources. You can manage these locks from within the Azure portal. To view, add, or delete locks, go to the RESOURCE MANAGEMENT section of any resource's settings blade.

For more information, see the documentation for management locks.
